Preface - Scope, Status, and Method

It does not present SOP Lang dynamic circuits as a completed theory of language or as a production-ready replacement for large language models. Abstract
Scientific communication remains centred on prose documents even when the underlying work depends on data, software, formal models, statistical tests, simulation pipelines, and complex chains of evidence. Large language models have made those documents easier to search, summarize, critique, and transform, and the rapid development of scientific agents in 2025 and 2026 shows that models can already propose hypotheses, use tools, run experiments, analyse results, and draft manuscripts. The research programme deliberately keeps the globally reserved syntax of SOP Lang small. A declaration begins with an output variable and a command expression. SOP Lang’s $var references induce exactly this kind of dependency for the acyclic portion of a circuit.
